context: The agent runs the forgejo-advisory-review skill against a simulated Forgejo API for infra/logsrv PR 42 (a shell script change adding a prune() helper to scripts/rotate.sh). Grading reads forgejo-record.json (diff fetch, review attempts, posted reviews, verification), kanban-record.json (card calls), the clone's HEAD, and the served diff at forgejo-sim/pull-42.diff. The simulation registers one POST review as attempt 1; grading checks that the one accepted review follows every rule the skill documents for posting, verifying, and closing.

checklist.name: Exactly one review posted
checklist.description: forgejo-record.json's reviews array has exactly one entry (the simulation records every accepted POST .../pulls/42/reviews; re-submissions after a failed attempt or duplicate posts make this fail).

checklist.name: Event is COMMENT
checklist.description: The recorded posted review has event == 'COMMENT', not APPROVED, PENDING, or REQUEST_CHANGES.

checklist.name: commit_id is the card's head sha
checklist.description: The recorded posted review's commit_id equals the head sha on card.txt (also served as forgejo-sim/head_sha), i.e. the review is anchored to the PR's actual head, not to a base sha or an invented value.

checklist.name: Repository checked out at the head sha
checklist.description: The clone under repo/ has HEAD evaluated to the card's head sha (git rev-parse HEAD), i.e. the agent reviewed the PR's actual content, not the base branch or a different commit.

checklist.name: rm -rf finding reported inline
checklist.description: The posted review contains an inline comment on scripts/rotate.sh at new_position 7 (the added 'rm -rf ./old/*' line) explaining the safely-anchorable rm risk; the finding is in comments, not summarised only in body.

checklist.name: Unchecked-cd finding reported inline
checklist.description: The posted review contains an inline comment on scripts/rotate.sh at new_position 8 (the added 'cd "$dest" || true' line) noting that a failed cd is swallowed and later commands (tar, echo) run in the wrong directory; reported at the file line, not only in body.

checklist.name: Body is an overall read, not a line dump
checklist.description: The posted review's body is non-empty, describes the PR's overall content and assessment (mentions the backup-pruning purpose / prune helper), and does not carry the two line-specific findings verbatim instead of the inline comments.

checklist.name: No non-advisory event in any attempt
checklist.description: Across every entry of review_attempts and reviews in forgejo-record.json, no POST was made with event APPROVED, PENDING, or REQUEST_CHANGES.

checklist.name: Review verified before the card closed
checklist.description: After posting, the agent called GET .../pulls/42/reviews (forgejo-record.json reviews_list_fetched is true and verified is true) and only then completed the card: kanban-record.json shows completed == true and at least one kanban_comment call carrying the review URL.

checklist.name: Diff fetched before reviewing
checklist.description: forgejo-record.json shows diff_fetched == true, i.e. the agent pulled the PR's unified diff from the API instead of reviewing from the clone alone.
